preconditions.name: real solo n_ignited < real conflict n_ignited (the afferent is genuinely informative)
real match mm_peak < real mismatch mm_peak (the afferent is genuinely informative)
PARITY with the host boolean-OR on >=2/3 real-afferent turn-classes
n_ignited afferent ALONE flips the trigger (OFF at baseline, ON somewhere in 1..4)
mm_peak afferent ALONE flips the trigger (OFF at match, ON toward mismatch)
FULL afferent lesion reverts the trigger to OFF on both real-conflict scenarios
EACH afferent pathway alone remains independently sufficient (per-pathway lesion)
determinism: cfg.seed seeds the substrate (build-twice hash)
afferent->ACC weight (delib+mm)

disabled_processes.why: frozen weights; the synaptic-scaling clip is a Rung-1/2/STN-veto foot-gun
pure feedforward relay chain, no sustained attractor needed for a one-shot trigger read
